build_libritts_dataset: build a BeamBasedBuilder to download and parse LibriTTS audio dataset with speech, text, and speaker metadata
create_split_generators: create split generators that download LibriTTS tar archives and produce dev, test, and train splits
extract_libritts_data: extract LibriTTS audio and transcript data from a tar archive yielding key-value example pairs
generate_transcripts: generate transcript examples from a TSV file yielding speaker, chapter, and normalized text fields
merge_dicts: merge partial example dicts by key to combine audio and transcript data into complete dataset records
